about_short_description.short_description: PayMint is a payment solution that allows businesses with an easy cashless payments and payroll management system.

product.name: Cashless Salaries
product.description: A platform feature that manages, tracks, and records employee salary payments including bonuses and incentives through cashless methods.

product.name: Immediate Salary Advance
product.description: A service enabling employees to access a portion of their salary before payday without complex procedures.

product.name: Immediate Transfer
product.description: A payment feature that processes approved transfer requests instantly.

product.name: Any Time Immediate Business Loan
product.description: A service providing small and medium-sized businesses with loans up to 3 million Egyptian Pounds without bank visits or lengthy procedures.

product.name: Pay Your Business Bills
product.description: A service that enables businesses to pay over 350 types of company bills including utilities and phone bills through the PAYMINT platform.
